# Scenario schema

A scenario is one YAML file in `scenarios/` (or saved from the console's builder) that fully describes a reproducible run. Unknown keys are rejected. The JSON Schema is served at `GET /api/reference/scenario-schema`; the console builder validates against it.

`scoring:` and `model_server:` are proto3-JSON documents of `ScoringConfig` / `ModelServerConfig` - see [config.md](config.md). Fields left out take the defaults listed there.

## `(top level)` - Scenario

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` |  |  |
| `description` | `str` | `""` |  |
| `seed` | `int` | `42` |  |
| `world` | `WorldSpec` | `(object)` |  |
| `traffic` | `TrafficSpec` | `(object)` |  |
| `fraud` | `FraudSpec` | `(object)` |  |
| `topology` | `Topology` | `"gateway-kafka"` |  |
| `rules` | `str` | `"baseline"` |  |
| `scoring` | `dict[str, Any]` | `{}` | proto3 JSON ScoringConfig |
| `model_server` | `dict[str, Any]` | `{}` | proto3 JSON ModelServerConfig |
| `budget` | `BudgetSpec` | `(object)` |  |
| `guardrails` | `GuardrailSpec` | `(object)` |  |
| `feature_sample_permille` | `int` | `1000` |  |
| `sync` | `SyncSpec` | `(object)` |  |
| `flink_state` | `Literal["warm", "fresh"]` | `"warm"` | warm: keep Flink keyed state + online-store blobs from earlier runs (realistic state size) fresh: start from empty state so `realy verify` can demand exact feature equality |
| `exactly_once` | `bool` | `False` | Flink transactional (exactly-once) decisions sink; the collector then reads read_committed, like any EOS consumer would - decisions become visible only when the checkpoint commits. |
| `expect` | `dict[str, Any]` | `{}` | e.g. {verdict: FAIL} |
| `pipeline` | `str` | `""` | the pipeline this scenario needs (contracts/pipelines/<name>.yaml); empty = any. The stack runs one pipeline (PIPELINE on every service), so a scenario of another pipeline is refused before it starts |

## `traffic` - TrafficSpec

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | `RateProfile` | `(object)` |  |
| `arrivals` | `Literal["uniform", "poisson"]` | `"uniform"` |  |
| `duration_s` | `float` | `60.0` |  |
| `warmup_s` | `float` | `10.0` |  |
| `time_scale` | `float \| Literal["auto"]` | `"auto"` | Simulated seconds per wall second. "auto" = the population's natural rate maps onto the target TPS, so each customer behaves realistically (rules fire at realistic rates). |
| `generators` | `int` | `1` | emitter processes (shards of the customer population) |
| `sim_start` | `str` | `"2026-11-02T00:00:00Z"` |  |
| `backfill_days` | `float` | `0.0` | unpaced history replay before the measured run |
| `flows` | `list[str]` | `[]` | transactions formed by several linked messages (contracts/transactions): the generator sends each matching payment as its messages, which the pipeline assembles back into one transaction |
| `event_types` | `dict[str, float]` | `{}` | message types other than payments (the pipeline's standalone types: logins, profile changes, card lifecycle, device telemetry): messages of each type per payment generated, so the load mix is explicit (2,000 payments/s with login: 0.6 also sends 1,200 logins/s). Each carries the entities of a payment of the same batch: its customer, card, device, IP (gen/sessions.py) |

| `end_tps` | `float \| None` | `None` | ramp end |
| `step_tps` | `float \| None` | `None` | step increment |
| `step_duration_s` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `spike_at_s` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `spike_duration_s` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `spike_multiplier` | `float` | `3.0` |  |
| `sine_period_s` | `float` | `600.0` |  |
| `sine_amplitude` | `float` | `0.3` |  |

## `fraud` - FraudSpec

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `background_per_1k` | `float` | `0.5` | Background campaigns started per 1,000 legitimate events (Poisson), and their mix. |
| `mix` | `dict[TypologyName, float]` | `see below` |  |
| `campaigns` | `list[CampaignSpec]` | `[]` |  |
| `unreported_fraction` | `float` | `0.10` | fraud never labelled |
| `friendly_fraud_per_1k` | `float` | `0.2` | legit events charged back (label noise) |
| `chargeback_delay_days` | `tuple[float, float]` | `(1.0, 45.0)` |  |
| `challenge` | `ChallengeSpec` | `(object)` |  |
| `auth` | `AuthSpec` | `(object)` |  |

Default `mix`: `card_testing` 0.22, `account_takeover` 0.15, `lost_stolen` 0.12, `counterfeit` 0.1, `merchant_breach` 0.08, `atm_cashout` 0.03, `app_scam_mule` 0.12, `bust_out` 0.06, `bot_ecom` 0.12

| `count` | `int` | `1` | number of campaigns started at `at_s` |

## Fraud typologies

`card_testing`, `account_takeover`, `lost_stolen`, `counterfeit`, `merchant_breach`, `atm_cashout`, `app_scam_mule`, `bust_out`, `bot_ecom`, `investment_scam` - described in [synthetic-data.md](../synthetic-data.md).
